data.body: Validation milestone: the immutable oracle first exposed legitimate post-basis mainline drift in freshness.py, fsutil.py, and push_recovery.py. The persisted row was corrected to implement the written acceptance criterion: frozen target identities are resolved from the immutable leaf parent; protected prose/directives compare parent to final; normalized executable AST remains exact; every target must be shorter. The drift audit preserved the new tracked/untracked stash distinction and added the current lazy sibling-helper import / acyclic dependency fact to the condensed fsutil module documentation. Plan certification remains current. Commit d4efe634ccfca changes exactly the 18 file-impact paths, comments/docstrings only. Green local evidence: immutable-prose-only, exact-leaf-paths, scoped Ruff/format, comment hygiene, diff integrity, and focused tests (1470 passed, 4 skipped, 1 existing warning in 705.50s). Per operator instruction, repository-wide make verify is intentionally deferred to Gerrit CI.
